MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable SSD fits my use of external storage while adding a convenient way to move files between computers.",
    "The HDMI switch could help my Blu-ray player and Fire TV share an input, and the Blink cameras offer a plausible extension of my basic door alarm setup that works with Alexa."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The internal drives require an upgrade project and compatibility checks I have not planned; owning an external backup drive does not mean I need enterprise storage or internal components.",
    "The headphones and cable multipack do not address a current need, while a separate microphone would need to solve a problem my webcam microphone cannot.",
    "The Fire TV Stick and Echo Show 8 fit my interests, but my recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max and Show 5 purchases make another similar device less useful right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My computer accessory purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any computer add-on, even when its purpose differs from what I use.",
    "My Alexa purchases seem to suggest I want more Alexa devices, without enough attention to which needs my recent purchases already cover."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in accessories that help my existing devices work together or add a useful capability than in duplicating something I just bought.",
    "My external drives and plug-and-play accessories make ready-to-use equipment a more natural suggestion than components requiring installation and compatibility checks."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my practical computer and Alexa interests, but miss the difference between a useful addition, a duplicate, and an upgrade I have no reason to undertake."
}
